headline: Brazil Central Bank Survey Raises 2027 Inflation and Interest Rate Expectations
summary: The Central Bank of Brazil's weekly Focus survey raised 2027 inflation projections to 5.12% and lifted expected benchmark Selic interest rates to 13.0% per year.
why: The Focus survey aggregates market expectations of top financial institutions, guiding Latin America's largest monetary policy stance.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Market analysts in Brazil raised 2027 inflation and policy rate forecasts.
